format: Paste conformance vectors. Core (Textarea.paste.test.ts) and Rust (tests/widgets.rs) run this file. A row is [name, pasted, textarea, input].
A Textarea and an Input hold "x" with the cursor at the end; pasted arrives as one bracketed paste. textarea and input are the texts they hold after it.
A paste drops terminal escape sequences in ESC and C1 form (a lone ESC and a cut-off sequence too), then every control character (Unicode Cc) but tab, LF and CR. Input also drops LF and CR.
rows: escapes with a digit or = final byte (DECSC, DECKPAM)
ESC-form strings, CSI in C1 form, and a BEL after ESC
C1 controls that open no sequence
a control character ends an escape before it goes
U+200B, U+FEFF and U+00AD (format characters) stay
lone CRs end lines, U+2028 and U+2029 stay
